Class BoundedQueueHandoff<T>

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.substrate.core.subscription.AbstractHandoff<T>
org.jwcarman.substrate.core.subscription.BoundedQueueHandoff<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of values transferred through the handoff
All Implemented Interfaces:
Handoff<T>
public final class BoundedQueueHandoff<T> extends AbstractHandoff<T>
FIFO bounded-queue handoff. Values sit in an in-memory queue with a bounded capacity so the feeder blocks on deliver(Object) when the consumer falls behind, providing backpressure. The terminal marker lives in a separate sticky field rather than being enqueued alongside values, so terminals never contend with values for queue capacity and cannot be dropped when the queue is full. Pending values always drain before the terminal is observed.

Used by Journal subscriptions, which need ordered delivery of every entry.

    • onTerminalSet

      protected void onTerminalSet()
      Description copied from class: AbstractHandoff
      Hook invoked under AbstractHandoff.lock after a terminal has been set and AbstractHandoff.notEmpty has been signalled. Subclasses override to wake additional conditions (for example, a notFull condition used for backpressure). The default implementation is a no-op.
